formulae.name: zsh-history-substring-search
formulae.desc: Zsh port of Fish shell's history search
formulae.caveats:
To activate the history search, add the following at the end of your .zshrc:

  source $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/share/zsh-history-substring-search/zsh-history-substring-search.zsh

You will also need to restart your terminal for this change to take effect.

formulae.name: zsh-syntax-highlighting
formulae.desc: Fish shell like syntax highlighting for zsh
formulae.caveats:
To activate the syntax highlighting, add the following at the end of your .zshrc:
  source $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/share/zsh-syntax-highlighting/zsh-syntax-highlighting.zsh

If you receive "highlighters directory not found" error message,
you may need to add the following to your .zshenv:
  export ZSH_HIGHLIGHT_HIGHLIGHTERS_DIR=$HOMEBREW_PREFIX/share/zsh-syntax-highlighting/highlighters
